_schema.note: Canonical catalog for the kids' first-bike quiz (index.html). Edit this file directly and push — GitHub Pages redeploys automatically. Optional live override: set SHEET_CSV_URL in index.html to a published Google Sheet CSV with the same column names; when set, it replaces this file's data at load time without a redeploy.

fields.name: string — model name shown to users
fields.origin: string — country of the brand, used for the 'prefer Canadian' filter
fields.wheel: number — wheel diameter in inches (16 or 20 typically)
fields.minH: number — cm, lower bound of the height this bike fits
fields.maxH: number — cm, upper bound of the height this bike fits
fields.price: number — face-value price in whatever 'currency' says (see below); the budget slider compares this number as-is and does not convert between currencies
fields.currency: optional string, 3-letter code (e.g. 'CAD') — omit to mean USD, the default for every entry added before this field existed
fields.exp: array of 'none' | 'balance' | 'training' | 'confident' — rider experience levels this bike suits
fields.seatRange: number — cm of seatpost height adjustment, used to estimate years of growth
fields.image: string — relative path (e.g. images/kids/cleary-gecko.jpg) or full URL to a product photo; leave empty to show the sketch placeholder
fields.retailerUrl: optional string — a specific product page URL, set ONLY when a human has actually opened that exact URL and confirmed it shows this bike (e.g. a page the user shared). Never guessed or constructed. When absent, the result card links to a live web search for the bike's name instead of a specific (possibly wrong or dead) product page — price/stock are the least stable part of any catalog entry, so we point to a live source rather than caching a number that will go stale.
